title: ML Studio 2026.11.21.1
notes:
- Use Ctrl or Command letter shortcuts on non-Latin keyboard layouts without switching languages.
- Multi-output instruments now play all available outputs by default. You can split individual outputs to separate mixer tracks when needed.
- Updated ML Drums, ML Trio and the stock delays, chorus, pitch, space and time tools. The included TIME-12 joins the stock effects.
- ML Reverb has independent ducking controls and a live stereo display. Hard ducking at 100% mutes the wet signal while audio comes in. Stock plugin parameter changes respond more smoothly.
- Mix Assistant uses revised processing decisions and level checks. Master Assistant and ML Plasma include updates to their native audio processing.
- Select and delete multiple channels in the Channel Rack. The selector shows channel activity, and new instruments, samples and automation sort into their matching groups.
- Playlist copies preserve the source on the same lane. Fast right-drag erase checks the full path, and the Playlist and Piano Roll support Ctrl-drag, right-drag and double-click-and-drag to draw loops. Shift-drag moves a loop.
- Double-click or middle-click to reset mixer controls immediately after a drag. Refined mixer view icons, meter alignment, knob highlights and hover redraws.
- Tap tempo from the toolbar, move the docked hint bar through its context menu, and change cursor size under Settings > General > Display. The Legacy cursor pack keeps its original artwork size.
- Fixed Channel Rack step colors, a crash when applying area color adjustments, and duplicate menu row highlights.
